establishedFacts: Pip considers himself the lead detective and plans every mission with serious notebook sketches.
Mox is easily startled, naps anywhere, and always protests his innocence before knowing the accusation.
June is the youngest sibling (scale 0.4) who treats the entire house as an obstacle course and secret lab.
Baked goods, cookies, and pizza slices serve as the de facto household currency.
Under the kitchen table is June's designated research and tactical outpost.
The house attic contains locked wooden chests with strange sounds at midnight.
Mox carries an emotional support yellow rubber duck that somehow survives extreme stunts.
runningGags: Mox shouting 'I was NOT there!' before Pip even finishes asking a question.
June justifying snack disappearances as 'controlled scientific sensory trials'.
Pip dropping his jaw whenever an obvious clue points directly back to him.

episodes.title: The Crumb Trail
episodes.hook: Two cookies. One plate. Now? Nothing.

episodes.challenge: Crossing the spinning neon hazard bridge to reach the checkpoint flag.
episodes.continuityCallback: Mox invokes his lucky rubber duck.
episodes.unresolvedThread: Is the duck truly heat-resistant for stage 10?

episodes.title: The Secret Attic
episodes.hook: Midnight. Strange scraping sounds above our ceiling.
episodes.continuityCallback: References June's clandestine lab extending into the ceiling.
episodes.unresolvedThread: Footsteps still pacing across the exterior roof.
